The Story Behind Little Springs Cattle Company

Also known as Little Springs Farm, Little Springs Cattle Co. carries a proud, decades-long legacy of raising premium beef cattle, including champion bloodlines. In recent years, we’ve shifted our focus to bring our pasture-raised beef directly to the tables of our local community.

Since opening our farm store in 2020, the incredible support from our neighbors has fueled our growth and inspired our vision for the future. Today, that same spirit continues to drive everything we do.

At Little Springs Cattle Co., the health and well-being of our cattle come first. With open pastures and nutrient-rich forage, we provide exceptional care every step of the way—because quality starts on the farm.

Whether you're shopping at our farm store, ordering online, or having our beef shipped to your door, you're getting more than just a great product. You're investing in local agriculture, supporting sustainable food systems, and helping build a stronger community—one bite at a time.

About Little Springs Cattle Co.
Our commitment at Little Springs Cattle Co. to excellence begins right at the source: our pastures, where our cattle roam freely from beginning to end.
Our Commitment

Our commitment to excellence begins right at the source: our pastures, where our cattle roam freely from beginning to end. We are deeply involved and invested in every aspect of their upbringing, from the moment they are born to the day they are processed. This hands-on approach ensures that each step is carried out ethically and sustainably, both for the well-being of the cattle and the land they call home. At every stage, we prioritize practices that promote restoration and harmony with nature.

Our Certifications

We take immense pride in our certifications, proudly holding GAP4 & CARE Certification. These certifications underscore our dedication to transparency and adherence to the highest standards of animal welfare and environmental stewardship. Our grass-fed, grain-finished approach not only enhances the flavor, texture, and marbling of our beef but also reflects our commitment to providing the best possible product to our customers.

Our Promise

Our promise extends beyond just what goes into our beef; it’s also about what doesn’t. We guarantee that our beef is 100% free of growth hormones, steroids, antibiotics, and GMOs. This commitment to purity ensures that every bite you take is not only delicious but also wholesome and natural.

We firmly believe that there’s tremendous power in knowing your farmer and understanding exactly where your food comes from. By fostering a connection between our customers and the land that sustains us, we aim to empower individuals to make informed choices about the food they consume. We’re advocates for local food systems and fervent believers in the importance of regenerative agriculture practices. It’s our belief that this is the future of agriculture, and we’re honored to play even a small role in ushering it in.

Why Choose Our Beef

When you choose our beef, you’re not just purchasing a product; you’re investing in a vision for a better, more sustainable future. You’re supporting local farmers who are dedicated to nurturing the land and the animals that inhabit it. You’re putting the power back into your own hands, making a conscious decision to prioritize quality, sustainability, and ethical practices.

So, from our pastures to your table, we extend our heartfelt thanks for trusting us with the fruits of our labor. We’re honored to be a part of your culinary journey and grateful for the opportunity to provide you with premium beef that’s not only delicious but also reflects our unwavering commitment to doing what’s right—for our cattle, our land, and our planet.
